name: plugin.embedding_cluster
description: Unsupervised text chunk clustering, topic keyword extraction, and cluster summary generator
author: Brain Harness Forge Engine

entrypoints.name: cluster_text_chunks
entrypoints.description: Cluster a collection of text documents or chunks into K topic groups based on TF-IDF representation

parameters.name: texts
parameters.description: List of text strings or objects with 'text' / 'content'

entrypoints.name: extract_cluster_topic_keywords
entrypoints.description: Extract top TF-IDF keywords characterizing a cluster group

parameters.name: cluster_texts
parameters.description: List of texts within a single cluster

parameters.name: top_n
parameters.description: Number of top keywords to return (default: 5)
